metadata.title: Ethereal Sunset Portrait with Monoline Script

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, medium-shot portrait of a person with short dark hair and visible tattoos, set against a vibrant, hazy sunset sky. The composition is crowned by a delicate, continuous-line script that arcs over the subject's head.
coreVisualRelationships: The subject's warm skin tones harmonize with the orange and pink sky gradient.
The monoline script acts as a halo, framing the subject's head.
Glitter on the hair and skin provides a specular highlight contrast to the soft, diffused background.
The upward tilt of the subject's head creates a diagonal line that leads the eye toward the typography.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered, lower-middle third, medium-close up scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the high-contrast glitter in the hair.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, moves up to the arced typography, then follows the curve of the shoulders and tattoos back down.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space in the upper half of the frame occupied by the sky and lettering.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Magenta and Rose Pink (Background sky and upper atmosphere)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm Amber and Gold (Lower sky and skin highlights)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background with a soft, high-key value range; subject is grounded with mid-tone shadows.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid cool blues or greens in the background

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Cursive script with exaggerated loops and long descenders
letterConstructionRules: Circular, loopy flourishes on ascenders and descenders
Arced baseline following the curve of the subject's head
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 's' features a large, circular bottom loop
Lowercase 'f' and 'g' have extended, rounded descenders that fill negative space

composition.relationshipToImage: Floating above the subject like a crown

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Stand-alone custom lettering to maintain an organic, personal feel.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the hand-drawn, intimate quality of the original.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Learning Curve or similar schoolhouse scripts
candidateDirections.reason: Provides the basic monoline cursive skeleton if modified.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-resolution portrait of a person with short dark hair and tattoos, skin glistening with gold glitter, looking slightly upward. The background is a soft-focus, ethereal sunset sky with clouds in a gradient of magenta, pink, and warm orange.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply custom monoline script lettering in a creamy white color. The text should be arranged in a gentle upward arc centered above the subject's head, featuring fluid, loopy cursive connections.

verificationChecks: Is the sky gradient smooth and vibrant?
Does the lettering have a consistent monoline weight?
Are the specular highlights on the skin and hair prominent?
Is the text arced correctly over the subject?

mustRedesign: Specific tattoo patterns (use generic artistic tattoos)
Exact facial features of the model
Specific brand logos or unique identifiers

mustAchieve: Seamless integration of subject and background

postGenerationChecks: Check for color banding in the sky gradient.
Ensure the script feels hand-drawn rather than a standard font.
Verify the glitter effect looks like light reflecting, not noise.
Confirm the subject's pose feels natural and ethereal.
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject [Portrait Type] + Background [Sunset Gradient/Clouds] + Texture [Glitter/Specular] + Typography [Monoline Arced Script]
